entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-07-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Obsolete UseWebAssemblyDebugging and remove it from Blazor project templates #67858
  • Deprecate the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Components.WebAssembly.DevServer package #67857
  • ProducesResponseTypeAttribute<T> / ServiceFilterAttribute<T> / TypeFilterAttribute<T> silently lose AllowMultiple across controller inheritance — they don't redeclare [AttributeUsage] #67856
  • DBSC: separate browser-advertised endpoint URLs from local handler paths #67850
  • Kestrel does not validate the query component of HTTP/2/3 :path, allowing raw whitespace/control chars #67849
  • Design Proposal: Footer Templates for QuickGrid and Its Columns #67848
  • Design proposal: OIDC token storage option for Blazor WebAssembly #67847
  • Design Proposal: Provide a JavaScript Signal for Interactive Rendering #67846
  • Design for Add RoutePrefix Parameter to Blazor Router for Localized URL Support #67845
  • Ensure test coverage and correct behavior for OpenAPI when minimal API parameter is `T?[]` #67844
  • Proposal: Synchronize form reset behavior with EditContext and InputBase #67843
  • Blazor wasm publish: MSB4018 ApplyCompressionNegotiation #67842
  • Design for Enhance nullability support for TValue in EventCallback #67841
  • `FormOptions.MultipartHeadersLengthLimit` not enforced when a multipart header line spans multiple `BufferedReadStream` buffers #67838
  • Design Proposal: Make ColumnBase.IsSortableByDefault() Public in QuickGrid #67837
  • Design for preserve null values for in single select binding #67835
  • Design Proposal: Dynamic Columns for QuickGrid #67834
  • Design Proposal: Expose QuickGrid Columns to Derived Classes #67833
  • Proposal: Add object-level validation APIs to EditContext #67832
  • Proposal: Add QuickGrid OnDataLoading and OnDataLoaded Events #67831
  • QuickGrid - Add built-in localization for pagination #67830
  • Proposal: Custom Comparer Support for QuickGrid In-Memory Sorting #67829

Closed

  • [API Proposal] Client-side validation for Blazor static SSR forms #67800
    11.0-preview7
  • Valid state behavior differs across render modes #67071
    11.0-preview7
  • ASP.NET Core Logging Integration File Not Found Exception #66315
  • WebViewJSRuntime should throw JSDisconnectedException when PageContext is disposed (parity with RemoteJSRuntime) #66255
    11.0-preview7
  • CsrfProtectionMiddleware introduced in .NET 11 Preview 6 does not considers the QUERY method #67825
  • Blazor Gateway dev-server gaps for runtime/WBT #67814
    .NET 11 Planning
  • OpenAPI: Populate discriminator `defaultMapping` for non-abstract base types that include self `JsonDerivedType` #65724
    .NET 11 Planning
